title: manufacturing.plan input
description: The plans to work out, in order (CR-D5: a whole page's in one call): each a batch/lot record, the dose (mg TPE per unit), the units asked for and the certificate's TPE.

source.description: The state's harvest batch or process lot record; only analyteWeight (mg/g: a JSON number, anything else is no potency, DOSE-13) and dryWeight (g, read as records::dry_grams reads it, RD-2, DOSE-14) are read.

coa_tpe.description: The certificate's TPE (mg/g), or null; a value that isn't a JSON number of 0 or more counts as none, and is echoed back as given, except a figure that isn't finite (JSON can't carry one: text that reads as one, such as "inf", "-inf" or "nan", as the server hands it over), which is a refusal and is echoed as null (final review I1).
